estado.description: Resume the project: read the handoff and the git state, change nothing
estado.template: Read docs/PROJECT_STATE.md, then run `git status`, `git log -10 --oneline` and `git diff --stat`. Tell the user, in Spanish, where the project stands, what was left uncommitted and the most likely next step. Do not modify any file.

build.description: Build the WinUI app once and report only the errors
build.template: Run `mise run build` inside app/ (one dotnet process only) and report the result: errors, warnings, and nothing else. Do not launch the app.
